entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: an elven carpentry workshop. A square pale wood workshop, one side open under a curved leaf-shaped lean-to roof, a slender wooden crane over the opening, planks and a half-built bolt thrower inside, a blue banner.

style.suffix: Pale ivory stone and smooth silver-grey living wood, sweeping curved leaf-shaped roofs, slender pillars, gold trim, climbing vines. Graceful low-poly shapes, clean edges, flat faces. Isolated building, no ground, no text, no characters.
style.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Stone: pale ivory (#E6E0CE). Wood: silver birch grey (#BDB5A2). No text or logos.
